caveats: Every finding here is a lead for human review. Nothing in this report is a determination of guilt.
Risk scores rank the review queue; they are not evidence and are not presented as such.
No finding reached 'confirmed'. The case rests on probable and possible inferences, and should be treated accordingly.
The recoverable figure is an estimate from stated assumptions, not a commitment that those funds will be returned.
No exculpatory material was identified. That is not the same as none existing — it means none was surfaced by the checks that ran.
